Krátke odpovede, ktoré pomôžu vybrať rit: Short answers to help you choose a ritual and get ready for your visit.
Ako si vybrať správny rituál?: How do I choose the right ritual?
Ako súvisí HEAD SPA 30 so Salónom 30?: How is HEAD SPA 30 related to Salón 30?
HEAD SPA 30 je Head Spa koncept kaderníc: HEAD SPA 30 is the Head Spa concept of the Salón 30 hair salon and operates in its rooms at Mostná 30 in Nitra. The same address and the same team. Hairdressing, colouring, colour work and the trichology examination are at www.salon30.sk; the Head Spa rituals have their own price list here on this page.
Musím si pred návštevou umyť vlasy?: Do I have to wash my hair before the visit?
Nie je to potrebné, pretože umytie a sta: There is no need, because washing and care are part of the ritual. If your scalp has specific needs, mention them during the consultation.
Je Head Spa vhodné aj pre mužov?: Is Head Spa suitable for men too?
Áno. Ponuka obsahuje samostatnú pánsku k: Yes. The offering includes a separate men's category with 45-, 60-, 90- and 120-minute rituals.
Môžeme prísť dvaja spolu?: Can the two of us come together?
Áno. V ponuke sú dva spoločné rituály pr: Yes. There are two shared rituals for 2 people: the Shared Head Spa ritual and the Shared ritual under the stars.
Je v rituáloch zahrnuté vysušenie vlasov: Is blow drying included in the rituals?
Pri Head Spa rituáloch je záverečné vysu: For the Head Spa rituals, the final blow dry or professional blow dry is listed directly in what that particular service involves.
Na karte rituálu alebo hore na stránke ť: Tap Book on the ritual card or at the top of the page. Our online booking through Booqme opens, where you choose the ritual, the day and the time yourself. If you are unsure what to choose, call us and we will help.
Ako dlho rituál trvá a koľko stojí?: How long does a ritual take and what does it cost?
Dá sa Head Spa darovať?: Can Head Spa be given as a gift?
Áno. Darčekový poukaz kúpiš online karto: Yes. You buy the gift card online by card through Booqme and it arrives by e-mail straight away with a code the recipient enters when booking. You can give an amount or a specific ritual, or order the card by e-mail and collect it at the salon.
Ako sa pripraviť na návštevu?: How should I prepare for the visit?
Stačí prísť pár minút vopred. Vlasy nemu: Just arrive a few minutes early. You do not have to wash your hair, but ideally without much styling product and natural, without hairpieces, so we can reach the scalp directly. For the cosmetic ritual it is better to come without make-up.
Je Head Spa vhodné pri farbených alebo p: Is Head Spa suitable for coloured or extended hair?
Farbené vlasy väčšinou nie sú problém. A: Coloured hair is usually not a problem. If you coloured it in the last 48 hours, or you have hair extensions, dreadlocks or braids, tell us when booking. Some steps of the ritual need direct access to the scalp, so we will adapt them.
Rituál prebieha v ľahu na chrbte, v polo: The ritual takes place lying on your back, in a position that is comfortable for you. If you are pregnant, tell us when booking, and with a high-risk pregnancy speak to your doctor first.
Ako často chodiť na Head Spa?: How often should I come for Head Spa?
Ako oddych kedykoľvek, keď to potrebuješ: As a break, whenever you need it. If you want a visible effect on the scalp, regularity makes sense, for example once every three to four weeks. At the consultation we will suggest a rhythm based on the condition of your scalp.
Čo si obliecť a čo si priniesť?: What should I wear and bring?
Nič špeciálne. Pohodlné oblečenie, počas: Nothing special. Comfortable clothes; during the ritual you lie on your back. The towel, the products and the blow dry are part of the ritual. Leave your phone in your bag, at least for those few dozen minutes.
Je to vhodné pre citlivú pokožku hlavy?: Is it suitable for a sensitive scalp?
Povedz nám o citlivosti, lupinách alebo: Tell us about sensitivity, dandruff or allergies during the consultation at the start. We adapt the pressure of the massage, the water temperature and the products to what your skin can take.
Môžem prísť s dieťaťom?: Can I come with a child?
Áno. V ponuke je Detský ovocný Head Spa,: Yes. There is a Children's fruit Head Spa, a 50-minute ritual made for children. If you want to come together, book slots next to each other or call us and we will arrange it.
